name: 使用 SAP Risk and Assurance Management 的控制监控 (3KY)
name_en: Control Monitoring with SAP Risk and Assurance Management (3KY)
description_en_html:
Overview

With SAP Risk and Assurance Management, the compliance manager defines controls and procedures to monitor operational processes and detect anomalies when connected to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system.

Operational processes generate many documents on a daily basis. This scope item enables continuous monitoring of transaction information and detects activities that may cause a financial loss, reputational damage, or other negative consequences for your organization. The results from these monitored processes provide insights regarding the operational processes within a company.

Key Process Flow

  • Create automated procedures
  • Create controls
  • Create work packages
  • Run automated procedures
  • Display automated procedure run result
  • Handle issue processing for line items from automated procedure

Business Benefits

  • Reduce the manual activities by automatically checking and monitoring financial processes in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
description_zh_html:
概览

通过 SAP Risk and Assurance Management，合规性管理器定义了控件和程序，以监控操作流程并在连接到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统时检测异常。

运营流程每天都会生成许多凭证。此范围项目支持持续监控交易信息，并检测可能对组织造成财务损失、声誉损害或其他负面影响的活动。这些受监控流程的结果提供有关公司内运营流程的分析。

关键流程流

  • 创建自动化程序
  • 创建控制
  • 创建工作包
  • 运行自动化程序
  • 显示自动化过程运行结果
  • 处理自动化程序中行项目的问题处理

业务优势

  • 通过自动检查和监控 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中的财务流程来减少手动活动
